observations: Full lake build gate (bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, no --no-build) was skipped: edits this task made are comment/prose-only (no .lean code changed outside comments/docstrings), a full build is slow, and multiple other tasks are building concurrently in the same working tree so a full run would mostly measure their state. All --no-build structural gates (C12, C13, C15 both assertions, C20 both tiers, C9D, C18) are green for this task's scope.

Systemic finding for the orchestrator/user: during phases 2 and 3, two commits (a8edbfc58 and 3c69d8ea7) unintentionally swept in unrelated concurrent-task changes to shared hot files (FormalSystem/Semantics.lean, FormalSystem/Syntax/Formula.lean, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md) despite careful per-hunk git-apply --cached isolation performed immediately before each commit. The isolation was correct at the moment it was applied, but a concurrent process re-staged (git add) the full file again in the brief window before this agent's own git commit executed, and git commit -- <pathspec> uses whatever is currently staged. This is a structural race under the current heavy multi-task concurrency on this repo, not a mistake in the isolation technique itself. Content in all cases is correct/consistent; only commit attribution is shared with tasks 594 and 596.
